For the information functional, let the baseline displacement \(q=(z,w)\) be Gaussian with covariance \(\theta K^{-1}\), and define auxiliary contacts \(x=U^Tq+\epsilon_X\), \(y=V^Tq+\epsilon_R\). The noises are independent of each other and of \(q\), with covariances \(\theta I/a\) and \(\theta I/b\). Write \(D=D_{00}\) and
\[
 P_w=U_w^TD^{-1}U_w,\quad Q_w=V_w^TD^{-1}V_w,\quad R_w=U_w^TD^{-1}V_w,
 \qquad
 \Sigma_{xy\mid z}=\theta\begin{pmatrix}P_w+I/a&R_w\\R_w^T&Q_w+I/b\end{pmatrix}.
\]
Here \(U_w,V_w\) are the omitted-coordinate rows of the bundles. With \(\Sigma_{x\mid z}\) and \(\Sigma_{y\mid z}\) the diagonal covariance blocks, the retained Gaussian functional is
\[
 I(x;y\mid z)=\frac12\log\frac{\det\Sigma_{x\mid z}\det\Sigma_{y\mid z}}
 {\det\Sigma_{xy\mid z}}=-f(D)=f(S)-f(K)\ge0.
\]
Logarithms are natural, so information is in nats. The covariance is independent of the conditioning value \(z\). This definition assumes the same positive-definite internal-coordinate baseline and positive prescribed spring coefficients as above; its artificial independent noise is not a measured molecular noise model.\footnote{Retained derivation: \texttt{ada/conditional-information.md}; the determinant functional is explicitly implemented in \texttt{ada/check\_conditional\_information.py}, function \texttt{information}. No new computation is used here.}

Define the normalised omitted overlap on the Gram supports by
\[
 C_w=(P_w^+)^{1/2}R_w(Q_w^+)^{1/2},\qquad s_j=\sigma_j(C_w),\qquad
 \ell_D=\frac12\sum_j\log(1-s_j^2).
\]
The superscript \(+\) denotes the Moore--Penrose inverse, followed by its positive square root; dependent bundle columns are allowed. For all supported singular values \(s_j<1\), the prescribed positive-addition model obeys
\[
 \ell_D\le f(D)\le0,\qquad f(S)+\ell_D\le f(K)\le\min\{0,f(S)\}.
\]
The omitted-cycle lower limit is approached as both positive spring coefficients grow without bound on their supports. A shared supported direction with \(s_j=1\) gives no finite uniform lower bound; finite known positive strengths still give a finite exact correction. Empty bundles give zero cycle. These are dimensionless stiffness-cycle bounds, not bounds on binding non-additivity.\footnote{Retained definitions: \texttt{emmy/marginal-bounds.md}, omitted-response section, and \texttt{branches/branch-3/emmy/rank-m-bridge.md}, supported whitened overlap and positive-addition bound.}

changes.after: Omission alone need not break the spring representation. On the same positive-definite internal coordinate space at all four corners, with fixed minima, offsets, configurational measures and kinetic terms and prescribed additive positive bundles, exact zero conditional cross-compliance \(U_w^TD_{00}^{-1}V_w=0\) is a sufficient condition for additive positive effective retained bundles after Schur reduction. This includes the case where one bundle is retained-only, and also permits both bundles to touch omitted coordinates. Under this condition the omitted determinant cycle vanishes, so the full and retained stiffness cycles agree. A merely small conditional information does not imply this exact additive representation. These sufficient fixed-space conditions do not validate chemical replacements.\footnote{Retained derivation: \texttt{emmy/marginal-bounds.md}, fixed-space assumptions and exact bundle reduction; joint entries 25 and 29.
